title: Sidelink radio link failure related actions

entities.name: Sidelink Radio Link Failure Detection
entities.description: Procedure triggered when UE detects sidelink radio link failure for a specific destination based on various failure indications.

entities.name: Timer T400
entities.description: Timer used for sidelink communication that when expired triggers sidelink radio link failure detection.

entities.name: Maximum number of retransmissions reached
entities.description: Condition where sidelink RLC entity indicates maximum retransmissions for a specific destination have been reached.

entities.name: Maximum number of consecutive HARQ DTX reached
entities.description: Condition where MAC entity indicates maximum consecutive HARQ DTX for a specific destination have been reached.

entities.name: Integrity check failure
entities.description: Condition where sidelink PDCP entity indicates integrity check failure for SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3 for a specific destination.

entities.name: DRB release
entities.description: Property where UE releases DRBs of the destination according to specified clause.

entities.name: SRB release
entities.description: Property where UE releases SRBs of the destination according to specified clause.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection released
entities.description: Property where UE considers PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination.

entities.name: RRC connection re-establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated when UE is connected with L2 U2N Relay UE via PC5-RRC connection.

entities.name: Sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE after sidelink radio link failure detection.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: UE RRC state where UE is connected to the network.

relations.description: Sidelink RLF detection is triggered by maximum retransmissions reached indication
Sidelink RLF detection is triggered by T400 expiry
Sidelink RLF detection is triggered by maximum HARQ DTX reached indication
Sidelink RLF detection is triggered by integrity check failure indication
Sidelink RLF detection establishes DRB release
Sidelink RLF detection establishes SRB release
Sidelink RLF detection establishes PC5-RRC connection release
Sidelink RLF detection includes RRC connection re-establishment procedure when UE is connected with L2 U2N Relay UE
Sidelink RLF detection includes sidelink UE information procedure
RRC connection re-establishment procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state
